paragraphs.text: Plan A puts you in a strong position at SMU MSFE: its minimum cumulative GPA is 3.20 and IELTS 6.5, and you have 3.2 and 6.5. It costs SGD 57700 for the whole course plus S$61200 of pay not earned over 18 months, ending 2028-07. It only works if your final transcript stays at 3.2 or above and 400,000 CNY covers SGD 57700, and no tool here converts CNY.

marks.quote: your final transcript stays at 3.2 or above
marks.why: You are exactly at the SMU minimum, so any drop closes this route.
Confirm this fee on SMU's official page.

paragraphs.text: Plan B is the shortest study route aimed at fintech: 12 months ending 2028-01, with S$40800 of pay not earned. It aims at Data Engineer, which MOM flags as a 'needs' role in financial services at S$10,074 (June 2025). The tool lists no fee for SUTD, and the data doesn't show which modules teach Programming and Coding to level 3, the gap your finance degree leaves.

paragraphs.text: Plan C spends no tuition at first: you search for Enterprise Risk Management Associate and Assistant Wealth Planner roles for six months, and you fall back to UCD MSc (Global Finance) at SGD 38695 for the whole course if nothing comes. The financial-services EP floor is S$6200 for applications before 1 Jan 2027 and S$6600 from 1 Jan 2027, and the Kaplan graduate median is S$3400. It also reverses the order your parents want.
